fsm_states_server_transaction.name: WAIT_FOR_MB_INDICATION
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Idle. Server waits for an incoming MODBUS request ADU.

fsm_states_server_transaction.name: VALIDATE_FUNCTION_CODE
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Check FC is supported. If not → ExceptionCode 0x01.

fsm_states_server_transaction.name: VALIDATE_DATA_ADDRESS
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Check Address + Quantity in range. If not → ExceptionCode 0x02.

fsm_states_server_transaction.name: VALIDATE_DATA_VALUE
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Check quantity/byte-count/value within per-FC limits. If not → ExceptionCode 0x03.

fsm_states_server_transaction.name: EXECUTE_MB_FUNCTION
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Perform the action. On unrecoverable failure → ExceptionCode 0x04/0x05/0x06/0x08.

fsm_states_server_transaction.name: SEND_MODBUS_RESPONSE
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Compose normal response PDU and transmit.

fsm_states_server_transaction.name: SEND_MODBUS_EXCEPTION_RESPONSE
fsm_states_server_transaction.description: Compose exception PDU (FC | 0x80, Exception Code) and transmit.

fsm_states_client_transaction.name: BUILD_REQUEST
fsm_states_client_transaction.description: Client constructs PDU per FC-specific layout.

fsm_states_client_transaction.name: TRANSMIT_REQUEST
fsm_states_client_transaction.description: Client sends ADU on the chosen transport.

fsm_states_client_transaction.name: RECEIVE_RESPONSE
fsm_states_client_transaction.description: Wait for end-of-frame; validate CRC/LRC implicitly.

fsm_states_client_transaction.name: TIMEOUT
fsm_states_client_transaction.description: No response within timeout → report to application.

fsm_hints.validation_order: Function code → Data address → Data value → Execute (Figure 9).
fsm_hints.broadcast_handling: Address 0 = broadcast; server processes but does NOT respond.
fsm_hints.abort_conditions: Communication error → silent discard; no exception response.
fsm_hints.no_response_class: Exception 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE prevents client timeout for long programming commands.

anti_deadlock_rule: Strict request/reply: only the client initiates; the server replies (or stays silent on broadcast / communication error). On Modbus TCP, MBAP.Transaction_ID lets the client correlate concurrent responses.
exit_from_reset_or_power_up: After server power-up, all communication counters and the diagnostic register start cleared; data tables hold their power-on defaults. Server is ready to accept the first MODBUS request without further client-side initialization.

default_state_recommendation.serial_line_idle: Both directions idle (UART idle HIGH / TXD = mark).
default_state_recommendation.tcp_socket_initial: Client opens TCP connection to server's port 502.

exception_response_logic.trigger: Any failed validation gate (function / address / value / execute).
exception_response_logic.pdu_layout: (FC | 0x80, 1 B) + (Exception Code, 1 B). Total exception PDU = 2 bytes.
exception_response_logic.client_action: Inspect response.byte[0] MSB. If 1, treat as exception.

diagnostics_listen_only_mode.trigger: FC 0x08 sub-function 0x0004 Force Listen Only Mode.
diagnostics_listen_only_mode.behavior: Server stops responding to all requests until sub-function 0x0001 Restart Communications Option.
diagnostics_listen_only_mode.rationale: Allows offline troubleshooting without affecting other devices on a multi-drop bus.

interrupt_priority_order: Not applicable at the protocol layer.
